items.title: Electrocatalytic Carbon Dioxide Reduction Coupled with Alcohol Oxidation
topics: Renewable Energy, Sustainability and the Environment
items.evidenceSource: fresh compact handoff title and abstract; publisher page used where accessible
items.reason: The title could describe paired electrosynthetic organic synthesis or an energy-focused CO2 conversion study, and no abstract/full text is available.
items.evidenceBasis: The fresh compact handoff supplies the title, authors, date, Crossref/OpenAlex provenance, and energy/catalysis topics but no abstract. Publisher TOC, landing, abstract, and full-text attempts did not yield usable content, so product identity, substrate scope, and preparative generality remain unverified.
items.challengeReason: The challenge pass tested both plausible readings: useful paired alcohol oxidation could qualify, while an electrocatalytic energy study would not. Without article-level evidence, neither include nor exclude can be defended.
items.evidenceNeeded: Publisher abstract or正文 showing the alcohol-oxidation products, substrate scope, isolated/preparative yields, and whether the work is general organic electrosynthesis rather than energy catalysis.
items.nextAction: Retry the CCS Chemistry article and TOC through the Tampermonkey/VPN Bridge; obtain title-plus-abstract or正文 evidence before finalizing the DOI.
